name: After vote
summary: Two to four tall cards fill with friends' faces as they vote, and the plan locks once everyone is in and one leads.
useWhen: picking between 2-4 options together: 'where do we go after the show', 'tacos or karaoke'
a plain poll that should end in one locked answer
dontUseWhen: nobody can decide and wants it picked for them (use slot-machine)

params.title: question, e.g. After the show?
params.clock: time now as H:MM, or empty for a plain poll
params.ends: H:MM the thing ends, or empty
params.meetAt: H:MM shown on the result, or empty
params.options: 2-4 x {name, meta, plan, icon: tacos|mic|roof|'' , voters: names}
